heroHeadline: Iran Defies International Pressure at UN, Vows to Protect Peaceful Nuclear Program
heroSubtitle: The IAEA Board of Governors voted 23–3 on Sept. 9 to send Iran's nuclear file to the Security Council after more than a year without inspector access; Tehran called the move 'completely counterproductive.' At home, rights groups documented dozens of new executions of protesters, the demolition of Gohardasht Prison, and Amnesty International's finding that the 2025–2026 crackdown mirrors the deadly 2022 repression 'on an even deadlier and more staggering scale,' while the rial hit a fresh record low near 2.29 million to the dollar.
